_recipe.title: Creator explainer (Hinglish)
_recipe.when: A creator explains one idea, tool or money / tech topic in Hinglish in ~30s.
beats: Hook: the topic as a question + the time promise ("30 second mein samjho").
Definition: the topic = its meaning in 1-3 words, then an everyday example (chai, cricket, EMI).
How it works: three numbered steps, 2-5 words each.
Galti vs sahi: the common mistake vs the right way.
Fact: one number with a source the creator can name.
CTA: comment a keyword / follow for part 2.
copyTips: Hinglish in Latin script on screen is fine; if the user writes Devanagari, keep Devanagari on screen and in say.
Numbers: screen "30", say "tees" (Hindi) or "thirty" (English): match how the creator speaks.
The fact beat needs a real source (RBI, SEBI, a report, the creator's own data). No source: cut beat 5.
Comment-keyword CTAs ("Comment karo NOTES") get more comments than "follow karo"; only promise a DM if the creator will really send it.
Midnight + snappy is the classic bold creator look. Finance / serious topics: --theme corporate. Tech / AI: --theme neon.
